## Known biases

Not assessed from the producer. The producer&\#x27;s own pages (NCEP EMC Stage IV page, NCO product page) could not be read: emc.ncep.noaa.gov/mmb/ylin/pcpanl/stage4/ and nco.ncep.noaa.gov/pmb/products/stage4/ return 404, the redirect target emc.ncep.noaa.gov/mmb/SREF/pcpanl/ returns 403, nomads.ncep.noaa.gov/pub/data/nccf/com/pcpanl/prod/ returned 503. So known limits stated by the publisher: not checked. The GDEX page describes the earlier prototype analysis (about 3000 hourly gauges plus WSR-88D radar estimates, bias-corrected radar) and says Stage IV data have been added since 2002-01-01.
